listening.title: Making Connections at the Trade Show

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Hi, I love your name tag design, are you from the marketing booth?

lines.speaker: Yen
lines.text: Yes, thanks! I saw your keynote session earlier, it was really informative.

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Thank you! Events like this are perfect for a warm introduction to new clients.

lines.speaker: Yen
lines.text: Agreed. Let's exchange information in case we want to follow up later.

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Sure, here's my card. Do you have a good conversation starter for new visitors?

lines.speaker: Yen
lines.text: I usually ask about their biggest challenge this year, it works well.

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Smart. This small crowd makes it easier to actually talk to people.

lines.speaker: Yen
lines.text: True, big events can feel overwhelming. I prefer to make a connection slowly.

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Same here. I already managed to collect a business card from three potential clients.

lines.speaker: Yen
lines.text: That's great progress! Let's grab coffee and compare notes after this session.
